value: GSE203499 (GEO), human retina and RPE/choroid scRNA-seq

Reproduced from raw Cell Ranger matrices with Scanpy; streaming QC+balanced downsampling to manage RAM; 33/33 bulk-detectable genes present; LYPLAL1 and ZDHHC6 broadly expressed, PPT2/ZDHHC16 restricted - consistent with manuscript.
